p: Rudolph started at quarterback on a short week, and the staff plans to build on his performance.
Rudolph played well enough to earn strong praise and a 'phenomenal opportunity' label, which helps his case for continued QB1 snaps, though McCarthy gave no explicit commitment.
Rudolph will start at quarterback for Pittsburgh against Denver.
Rudolph steps into the starting job on a short week with the offense adjusting its approach, which makes the passing-game outlook for Pittsburgh's skill players uncertain.
